text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking with Mejiro<n>Dober...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We were just on our way to see you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine and Hishiama? What did you<n>need me for?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Remember that hot pot roulette tea<n>party we had
before? We were<n>hoping to hold another one. What
do<n>you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-that again? ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, a while back, Fine invited us to a<n>tea party,
and...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone! Let's make a<n>mystery hot pot
that'll go well with<n>tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't tea parties usually involve<n>chiffon cake and
cookies? What kind<n>of hot pot would go with tea?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds fun! It'll be like<n>we're brewing a
potion! Let's put a<n>bunch of stuff in!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Let's not go overboard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is my first mystery hot pot. We<n>never did these
at the Mejiro estate...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is a first for me too! I'm sure it<n>will make for a
great reminiscent<n>clover!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who brought the most<n>interesting
ingredient? All right, let's<n>get this hot pot roulette
started! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Th-this looks kind of toxic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What's this? Rainbow candy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's my Special ☆ Magic<n>Candy! It has seven
mysterious<n>flavors and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yuck! Or it's supposed to, anyway!<n>What are these
bitter seeds?! It's not<n>sweet at all now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That must be my contribution. Ardan<n>gave me some
medicinal ingredients<n>to use.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Plus I got protein powder from Ryan,<n>so I put that in
too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! Those sound like really healthy<n>ingredients! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-I feel like my macarons are the most<n>normal thing
in there now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: By the way... What did you put in,<n>Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Me? Black pudding. ♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone but Fine
text_block_list.text: Ewwwww!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
After that, everyone made a fuss<n>about the smell,
and Hishiama got<n>really mad at us...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Going into the kitchen gave me the<n>scare of my life!
Some weird smoke<n>was pourin' out of it, and
everyone<n>had collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm gonna be there this time, so<n>nothing like
that'll happen again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We'll make it a fun and<n>delicious hot pot
roulette party this<n>time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... I'm sure it'll be fine<n>with Hishiama
there, but...
choice_data_list: Go on and make some fun memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...What are you so excited for?
choice_data_list:
You have what it takes to win, whether it's a race
or hot pot roulette.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not going to hold back if I'm<n>doing this,
but I don't know how well<n>I'll do...
choice_data_list:
You have what it takes to win, whether it's a race
or hot pot roulette.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Don't be ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pfft. Don't be silly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to head to the shopping<n>district and see
what tasty and<n>interesting things I can get, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to head to the shopping<n>district and see
what tasty and<n>interesting things I can get, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...See you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The second hot pot roulette party<n>concludes without
any strange<n>smells, but it apparently still tasted
diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Dober seems quite<n>satisfied,
since she was crowned Hot<n>Pot Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I was planning on doing solo<n>training today...
choice_data_list: You have to enjoy yourself outside of racing too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Who are you? My keeper?
choice_data_list:
Being with friends is one of the best parts of school
life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You really think so?
choice_data_list:
Being with friends is one of the best parts of school
life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...All right, fine. I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I suppose I'll go spend some<n>time with
everyone, then.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The second hot pot roulette party<n>concludes without
any strange<n>smells, but it apparently still tasted
diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The second hot pot roulette party<n>concludes without
any strange<n>smells, but it apparently still tasted
diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Mejiro Dober looks quite<n>happy as she
recounts the details of<n>the party to me.
